name: playerOnboarding
author: Takaro
description: Collection of functions that are executed when a player joins the server. Helps with onboarding new players, like sending a welcome message. The starter kit is an Item Set, managed on the server's Item Sets page.

message.title: Message
message.description: The message to send to the player when they join the server.

starterKitItemSet.title: Starter kit item set
starterKitItemSet.description: The item set a player receives when they run the starterkit command for the first time on this server.

starterkit.helpText: Get a starter kit, you can only execute this once on a server!
